summary: Identity/session foundation: services/api/clipos_api/identity.py with frozen Pydantic v2 User/Session contracts (status/state enums, validated email and timezone-aware datetimes, optional org_ref/rotated_from/idempotency_key), runtime-checkable SessionStore Protocol (get, put_if_absent with idempotency-key collision replay, update, delete, list_by_user), thread-safe InMemorySessionStore, and IdentityService with idempotent create (raw token returned once, SHA-256 hash stored), rotation (old revoked, successor.rotated_from set), idempotent revoke (no-op + no duplicate audit for already-revoked), touch, expiry resolved via injected clock, new_csrf_token, and cookie_attributes (httpOnly/secure/sameSite=Lax). Session create/rotate/revoke audit events go through existing clipos_api.audit; additive audit.read_events read helper added without changing record(). Pytest suite services/api/tests/test_identity.py covers contract validation, roundtrip, idempotency, hash-only storage, rotation, revoke idempotence, injected-clock expiry, touch, 100 unique CSRF tokens, cookie attributes, audit actions, and 8-thread concurrency (distinct keys -> 8 sessions; same key -> exactly 1). docs/development.md gained an 'Identity/session foundation' paragraph. No new third-party dependencies; no SQL/SQLAlchemy/alembic; no HTTP routes.
